blocking_reasons: Kafka staging authentication credentials are missing.
required_unblocking_actions: Export KAFKA_BROKERS pointing to AWS MSK staging cluster (e.g. b-1.ropus-kafka-staging.internal:9092).
Inject staging Kafka SASL/SCRAM credentials or mTLS certificates from AWS Secrets Manager.
Export CLICKHOUSE_HOST pointing to staging ClickHouse cluster.
Configure PROMETHEUS_PUSHGATEWAY_URL or Prometheus scrape config for /metrics.
handoff_instructions: 1. Provision staging AWS credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION) with SecretsManager:GetSecretValue permission.
2. Fetch ropus/production/credentials secret payload containing kafka_brokers and database credentials.
3. Export KAFKA_BROKERS, KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME, KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD, and CLICKHOUSE_HOST into shadow runtime.
4. Execute ml-service/evaluation/run_phase66_real_staging_activation.py to begin live shadow consumption.

governance_decision.blocking_reason: DATA_REQUIRED: Requires >= 50 confirmed real internal collusion labels from mature production cases before empirical calibration or promotion review.
governance_decision.next_required_action: Inject staging AWS Secrets Manager credentials to unblock real Kafka stream intake.
